summary: Nomadar Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing that its indirect parent, Cadiz CF, approved a reverse financial partial spin-off project filed with the Spanish Commercial Registry. The spin-off transfers Cadiz CF's equity interests in Sport City to Sport City, with shares allocated to Cadiz CF shareholders. This initial phase precedes a reorganization aiming to make Nomadar the parent of Cadiz CF, involving contributions of Cadiz CF shares to Nomadar for new common stock. No valuation or exchange ratio was specified. The spin-off awaits Cadiz CF shareholder approval around September 30, 2026. Completion is uncertain; watch for shareholder approval and regulatory progress.
